title: Service Questions
description: Answers service questions: the price of a scheduled service when asked, what a service includes, how long it takes, warranty, service contracts, service history, recovery prices, parts, a replacement car, offers and the connected car app

nodes.title: Begin
nodes.detail: Sets question_topic, question_detail, next_step, price_asked, includes_asked
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Per-activation initialisation. Every activation of this agent starts here, so it never starts with the outcome of the last one, old counters, an open tool gate or an escape flag that is still raised (after a safety hand-over, or in the demonstration, the call can come back to this agent). The safety note is left alone: it lasts for the whole call. A thread that is resumed after a hand-back continues in the assist step with its state intact, which is why the assist step and the constraints read what the supervisor passed (identity_status, vehicle_id) directly and nothing here is worked out from it in advance. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.title: Assist
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The reasoning step. It has no GOAL of its own, so it runs under the agent GOAL and the INSTRUCTIONS above (all thirteen cases). It ends when the model names the next step. Its tool list is not narrowed, so that the built-in return tool is certainly there; the three tools the flow owns are closed to the model by CONSTRAINTS (tool_step). MAX_ATTEMPTS counts caller turns that end without an outcome: eight of them go to a person (a backstop, not a use-case count). MAX_TURNS only caps the model and tool cycles inside one caller turn. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.title: Next step = done?
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Routing on next_step. One check per step; no model involved. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The model has answered and has said the closing question itself (INSTRUCTIONS step 21), so nothing is added here.

nodes.comment: The shared closing question (contract v2, section 2), after a fixed answer of the flow. It is used only where the flow is the one speaker of the turn. Where the model gave the answer (route_done, confirm_request, say_app_support) the model says this same line at the end of its own answer: a fixed line after a reasoning step that exits in the same turn is placed before the model's reply, not after it (platform guide, building scripted flows, "Key properties for reasoning steps").

nodes.title: Raise person

nodes.title: Prepare safety

nodes.title: Raise safety
nodes.comment: The flag is raised and the call is handed over in the same step, with no THEN.
